transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you to the clinic?

I've been hearing voices lately that other people tell me aren't really there, and sometimes I see things that don't make sense either. It's getting really scary and overwhelming, so I decided I needed to come in.
Have you also had times when your mood was unusually high or irritable with much more energy, less need for sleep, or risky behavior, or times when you felt very depressed or hopeless?
No, I haven't experienced those kinds of extreme mood highs or bursts of energy. I also haven't had any severe periods of feeling hopeless and depressed.
Aside from the voices and unusual beliefs, have you noticed a decline in your work, school, relationships, or self-care, or have the symptoms mostly stayed limited to one fixed belief?

Yes, my whole life has really gone downhill lately. I've lost all motivation to do my work or even basic daily chores, and I've completely stopped seeing my friends and family. Nothing brings me any joy or pleasure anymore, so I just stay isolated.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Schizophrenia, Delusional Disorder], but Delusional Disorder is now unlikely because the patient reports hallucinations (voices and visual experiences) and broad functional decline with negative symptoms (avolition, anhedonia, social withdrawal), which is more consistent with Schizophrenia. The absence of manic or major depressive episodes also makes mood disorders with psychotic features less likely.
